title: Greedy Little Bear Song | Sharing is Fun! Manipuri Kids Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Ei nupi-nupa amasung eikhoi! Ei song na sharing ta mapamna ngangna thaduna yakpa.
Sharing karigi nungsi eikhoi yumyum gi mapamda ngangduna piba.
Amasung ngaiba akhoi, mapam yumyum thoiba-u!

Thouba, thouba, yengnaro kkano?
Haoi thongda, tibba lairi!
Yam, yam, yam, yam
Haoi chiba, hurree!

Yam, yam, khaoi, thokpa, thokpa, thokpa
Haoi kana, thokpa mayam!
Chibba, chibba, chibba, chibba
Aigi thokpa, hurree!

Chup chup, thouba pumnam chagni
Hourak hourak, chiba lairakte
Chip, chip, chip, chip
Ayyo, ayyo, kari thokpage!

Yam, yam, khaoi, thokpa, thokpa, thokpa
Haoi kana, thokpa mayam!
Chibba, chibba, chibba, chibba
Aigi thokpa, hurree!

Thaba tongu, "Chagni, pliya,"
Uching heku, "Mapung thugatre!"
Thouba yengle, thongga phangle
Aroiba chamcha mikhai, hurree!

Yam, yam, khaoi, thokpa, thokpa, thokpa
Haoi kana, thokpa mayam!
Chibba, chibba, chibba, chibba
Aigi thokpa, hurree!

Imа nungangai, "Khut thiba laku,"
Mayam khutna lanba, hurree!
Ha, ha, ha, ha
Haoi mari, amuk unsi!
